# webtables/storage

> Where variables live: a stack in linear memory, and a globals area.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/storage.pkg)

Each section is an `i32` address expression. Functions keep their frame
pointer in the WebAssembly local `$fp`, laid out like bintables: locals
below it, parameters above it.

| section | for | address |
|---|---|---|
| `local` | a local variable | `$fp - 8(slot + 1)` |
| `param` | a parameter | `$fp + 16 + 8·index` |
| `global` | a `global` | `4096 + 8·index`, in the globals area |
| `decl` | declaring a global | nothing: memory starts zeroed |

See the [truck page](../webtables.md) for the whole memory map.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit local`

```nasm
(i32.sub (local.get $fp) (i32.const {offset}))
```

### `emit param`

```nasm
(i32.add (local.get $fp) (i32.const {offset}))
```

### `emit global`

```nasm
(i32.add (i32.const 4096) (i32.const {offset}))
```

### `emit decl`

```nasm

```
